targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(time / MAX(1, $__interval_ms / 1000) AS INTEGER) * MAX(1, $__interval_ms / 1000) AS time, AVG(CASE WHEN unit='K' THEN value-273.15 ELSE value END) AS value, group_name || ' / ' || sensor_id AS metric FROM readings WHERE group_name IN (${group:sqlstring}) AND metric='temperature' AND unit IN ('°C','K') AND time >= $__from / 1000 AND time < $__to / 1000 GROUP BY 1, group_name, sensor_id ORDER BY 1
